name: InitBufferedStream
evidence: sets mode -1, stores the flags, clears the read, next and count words and rounds the size up to 64 into end, moving start back by the rounding; returns the record (the S137290 record)

name: DestroyBufferedStream
evidence: closes the record with func_001373D0 and, with bit 0 of its flags argument, frees it with func_0018D778

name: OpenBufferedSectorStream
evidence: sets mode 1, stores the start sector at 0x48 and the byte count at 0x10, 0x14 and 0x40, and sets up the 2-or-more chunk ring (counts at 0x4C and 0x58 from the size / 0x100000)

name: OpenBufferedMemoryStream
evidence: sets remaining and the read pointer from its two arguments and mode 2 (read straight from memory)

name: OpenBufferedSectorStreamRange
evidence: passes a KeyId's two words (sector and byte count) to OpenBufferedSectorStream; func_001E4EA8 calls it on the stream it loads from

name: CloseBufferedStream
evidence: by mode closes the file handle (func_001F8C38, mode 0) or finishes the pending sector read (mode 1), then sets mode -1 and zeroes the pointers and counts

name: ReduceBufferedStreamBytesLeft
evidence: subtracts its count from the bytes left of a sector stream at +0x40 (set by OpenBufferedSectorStream) and returns the rest; ReadBufferedBlockHeader calls it

name: RefillBufferedStreamFromSectors
evidence: keeps the ring of chunk buffers filled: completes or restarts the sector reads (func_00140C28 or func_00140CC8 by flags bit 2) and sets rem to at most 0x8000 available bytes

name: RefillBufferedStreamFromFile
evidence: reads min(0x8000, remaining) bytes at the file offset with func_001F8DB8 and stores the result in the pending count

name: RefillBufferedStream
evidence: by mode refills from the file (func_001377C0) or the sector ring (func_00137490), reduces f14 by nextCount (floored at 0) and passes it to func_00193288 when f30 is set

name: UnpackBufferedStream
evidence: decompresses an LZ-style stream (flag bytes, literals, 13-bit back-references of length + 2) into a 0x2000-byte window at 0x70000000, refilling the input with func_00137820, and points cur and remaining at the output

name: ReadBufferedStreamBytes
evidence: copies size bytes to dst (or skips them when dst is 0), refilling through UnpackBufferedStream (flags bit 4) or RefillBufferedStream whenever the current chunk is empty

name: AlignBufferedStreamPosition
evidence: rounds the read pointer at 0x18 up to a multiple of n and takes the skipped bytes off the remaining count at 0x1C; func_001DBA38 calls it with 0x10

name: ReadBufferedU8
evidence: returns the next byte from cur, or reads one through func_00137A60 when remaining is 0

name: ReadBufferedU16
evidence: returns the next little-endian unsigned halfword, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 2 bytes remain

name: ReadBufferedU32
evidence: returns the next little-endian word as unsigned, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 4 bytes remain

name: ReadBufferedS8
evidence: returns the next byte sign-extended, via func_00137A60 when the chunk is empty

name: ReadBufferedS16
evidence: returns the next little-endian halfword sign-extended, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 2 bytes remain

name: ReadBufferedS32
evidence: returns the next little-endian word as signed, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 4 bytes remain

name: ReadBufferedFloat
evidence: assembles the next four bytes into a word and returns it as a float, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 4 remain

name: ReadBufferedVector3
evidence: reads 12 bytes into dst with func_00137A60; func_00192068 and the load slots use it for positions

name: ReadBufferedVector4
evidence: reads 16 bytes into out with func_00137A60

name: ReadBufferedRotation3
evidence: reads three 12-byte rows into buffer, buffer + 0x10 and buffer + 0x20 with func_00137A60

name: ReadBufferedMatrix4
evidence: reads four 12-byte rows into p, p+0x10, p+0x20 and p+0x30 and sets the fourth column to 0, 0, 0, 1.0

name: ReadMeshFromStream
evidence: reads a radius, a vertex count and vertices, then faces, a points array, a words array and an edge list into a mesh record, filling each face's vertex and edge indices from the stream and linking shared edges

name: ReadFaceTree
evidence: reads two counts, allocates 12-byte nodes and fills each with a face address (base + index*32) and back and front links by index (0xFFFF for none) from the buffered stream

name: ReadLinkedItemArray
evidence: reads a count, allocates 32-byte items and fills each from the stream: a vector, a float and two links stored raw when negative or as a pointer into the array otherwise

name: ReadBufferedString
evidence: reads a halfword size, allocates size+1 bytes, reads them from the buffered stream and NUL-terminates

name: SkipBufferedBlock
evidence: reads a halfword count and skips that many bytes of the buffered stream (ReadBufferedStreamBytes with no destination)

name: ReadOptionalBufferedBlock
evidence: reads 0x20 bytes and returns a front-memory copy of them, or 0 when words 1 and 7 of the block are equal

name: SetContactPairFlags
evidence: ors set and clears clr in the symmetric byte matrix at +0x1ADC for two table entries, and on reaching the linked state (low bits 0xF or bit 0x40) pushes a contact row each way with PushContactRow, on leaving it unlinks them and frees the chain

name: PushContactRow
evidence: takes a record from the pool at world+0x1AF0, clears its first word, stores the source's value, and pushes it onto the list head

name: UnlinkContactRow
evidence: walks a singly linked row list for the row whose other end is the key's owner, unlinks it and returns it

name: FindContactRow
evidence: walks the root's contact table for the row whose other end is the other object's root and returns it or 0

name: GetContactRowHead
evidence: returns the first word of the row FindContactRow finds, 0 when there is none

name: AddColliderToSweepAxes
evidence: RegisterCollider calls it: appends, in each of the world's three 0x1800-byte axis lists at 0x1AD8, a start entry pointing at the collider's bound at 0x420 and an end entry at 0x430 (one float per axis), then MarkSweepAxesUnsorted

name: RemoveColliderFromSweepAxes
evidence: UnregisterCollider's counterpart of AddColliderToSweepAxes: takes the collider's entries out of the three axis lists at 0x1AD8

name: MarkSweepAxesUnsorted
evidence: clears the world's 0x1AEC, so SortSweepAxes re-sorts the axis lists; AddColliderToSweepAxes and RecomputeColliderFrame call it

name: SortSweepAxes
evidence: when 0x1AEC is clear, insertion-sorts each of the three axis lists at 0x1AD8 by the bound each entry points at, calling SetContactPairFlags (func_001385A0) for the pairs whose start and end entries cross; UpdateWorldContacts calls it first

name: ClearRootObjectStateBits
evidence: clears the given bits of the root object's word at +0x4B8

name: UpdateWorldContacts
evidence: sorts the axes (SortSweepAxes), then for each pair of objects on the world's list at 0x6C rebuilds their contact chain (FreePooledContactChain, func_00188270) and calls the objects' children's slots 0x110 and 0x10C; LoadWorld, RunPendingWorldLoad and UpdateWorld call it

name: InitContactPairFlags
evidence: clears the object's +0x4B8 then, for each contact table in use but its own, calls func_001385A0 with a set or clear value of 8 chosen by slot 14 of either object

name: LoopOverMinCountNoOp
evidence: counts i from 0 to the smaller of its first and third arguments and does nothing in the loop; BuildCombinedBlendAnimation calls it

name: BuildCombinedBlendAnimation
evidence: creates a class 0x84 record (CreateTypedRecord) whose items and keys it allocates, merges the tracks of every item's source animation by key into shared position, rotation and weight curves (CreatePositionCurve, CreateRotationCurve, CreateWeightCurve) and copies the first source's timing fields; StartPlayer calls it four times

name: ComputeWrappedDeltas
evidence: for each element with an object at +4 fills a table of values from func_0012CCC0 and stores the difference to the previous one, adding the object's period at +0x34 when it is negative

name: ComputeBlendedDuration
evidence: sums weight times the source animation's duration at +0x34 over the items (a circular mean via WrapModulo per key range) and stores the result through its last argument, which SetBlendItemWeights passes as the animation's +0x34; it also fills each key's (start, length) pairs

name: FindCyclicRangeIndex
evidence: returns the index of the first (start, length) pair with a nonzero length that contains x modulo period, writing the offset into the range through out

name: SetBlendItemWeights
evidence: divides each listed player's time by the duration at +0x34, copies the item array (weights, stride and count from the caller) into the animation's data at 0xB8, recomputes the duration per key range with ComputeBlendedDuration and scales the times back; the mode colliders and the gauge holder call it after BuildCombinedBlendAnimation and after setting a weight to 1.0

name: SetBlendEntryRecordFlag
evidence: finds an entry with FindEntryByObjectId and sets the word at +0x18 of the record at its +8 to 1; the 0x8B object calls it on its combined animation after finding the object with id 0x36

name: BuildAlphaStatePacket
evidence: builds a GIF packet that writes GS register 0x47 (TEST_1) with 0x7180B and register 0x42 (ALPHA_1) from its index, detached into the word it is given

name: InitAlphaStatePackets
evidence: entry 23 of the startup table D_002647C0: builds the packets of g_alphaStatePacket1 and g_alphaStatePacket2 with BuildAlphaStatePacket (indices 1 and 2)

name: AcquireOwnedRecord
evidence: takes a 0x10C0-byte record from the pool at +0x1B40, clears it, sets its owner (and an extra 0x580-byte record when the owner's mode is 2) and links it into the owner's list at +0x624

name: DetachOwnedRecord
evidence: removes the record from its owner's list at +0x624 (owner at 0x108C) and appends it to the list D_002622F0

name: ResetFirstListedObject
evidence: takes the first object of the world list at +0x1CC0, sets flag bits, clears +0x2D0 and +0x620, sets +0x80 to 1e10 and calls its slot 6

name: InitWorldListedObject
evidence: slot 0: adds itself to its world's list at +0x1CC0, sets up members and sets flags and the float at 0x80

name: LeaveWorldLists
evidence: slot 6: removes itself from its world's lists at +0x1CC0 and +0x1CB4

name: ReleaseWorldListedObject
evidence: slot 7: walks the members list calling func_00139D28 on each, then removes itself from the world list at +0x1CB4 and D_002622E0

name: AssignAnimRecord
evidence: stores at 0x380 the record FindAnimRecord finds (g_animRecords when none), on the first call copies its four bytes at +4 halved into 0x594, then RebuildAnimRecordEntries

name: RebuildAnimRecordEntries
evidence: from the count in the record's block (byte at +4) picks a power of two below 0x20 for 0x384 and fills the 16-byte entries at 0x390 with func_001B2988; AssignAnimRecord and UpdateMatchingListedObjects call it

name: ApplyLookSourceToListedObject
evidence: copies colour count, colours (halved) and timing fields of a look record into a world-listed object, assigns its animation record, derives its rate from the register count and remaps the record's quadratic into curve2F0

name: UpdateWorldListedObject
evidence: slot 17: runs base updates then, unless the flagRecord's flags satisfy the global mask, calls its own method 3

name: CopyWorldListedObject
evidence: slot 23: copies from the source object and, when it is of class 0x50, keeps it as source and takes its float at 0x80

name: FilterParticleVerticesVu0
evidence: original assembly: loads a matrix into VU0 and runs the microprogram (vcallms 0x10) over an array of vertices, keeping those that pass the w test and wrapping the interpolated angle (WrapAngle) in kind 2 output

name: StepListedObjectParticles
evidence: original assembly: starts min and max bounds at plus and minus 3.4e38, moves particles in scratchpad chunks (StartToSprChain and StartFromSprChain DMA, FilterParticleVerticesVu0, TurnMatrixBySpin) and detaches the record when its list is empty

name: MoveWorldListedObject
evidence: class 0x4D's slot at 0x7C, the move slot of the other classes (MoveStateNotifier, MoveModeCollider)

name: SubmitWorldListedObjectBlock
evidence: slot 37: builds a zeroed 0x80-byte parameter block (count 0xF, radius from the source or 1.0, owner itself) and passes it to func_0019D410

name: WriteListedObjectParticlePacket
evidence: original assembly: the deferred-request function SubmitWorldListedObjectBlock installs: writes VIF unpack and STCYCL words and copies the particle words (CopyWordsToWriter) into the packet for each chunk of the listed object

name: UpdateMatchingListedObjects
evidence: for a nonzero mask walks the world list at +0x1CB4 and calls func_0013A008 on each object whose flag record has bit 0x10000000 or all of the mask's bits
